review.notes: Normalized full-text diff of every physical PDF page against the OCR markdown, followed by targeted renders. Verified visually: 150-dpi bottom strip of physical p.1 (author-symbol footnote line) and a 300-dpi crop of physical p.24 (Qwen2.5-VL reference entry). Table 1 (physical p.12), the EWMBench aggregate table (physical p.20) and Table 2 (physical p.21) are present as HTML tables with values matching the PDF text layer; per-page diff deltas on figure-heavy pages 2-18 come from diagram labels and chart values that live inside the embedded figures. Equations, the metric formulas in section 6.2, and the reference list (57 entries by year-ending count on both sides) survive intact; the remaining fix candidates were the three patches below.

patches.evidence: The OCR keeps the author-line markers (Yue Liao\*, Liliang Chen $^{\dagger}$, Shuicheng Yan $^{\diamond}$ ...) but dropped the page-1 footnote line. Rendered physical p.1 prints '* Equal Contribution. † Project Leader. ⋄ Corresponding Author.' below the footnote rule (verified on a 150-dpi render); restored after the front-matter block, using the same symbol markup the author line already uses.

The PDF spells the benchmark 'EWMBench' throughout (all 19 text-layer occurrences, including the sentence 'EWMBench provides a comprehensive evaluation framework...' on physical p.3); this single OCR line lowercased the 'b'. The abstract and section 6 headings in the same OCR file already read 'EWMBench'.

Rendered physical p.24 (300-dpi crop) prints the reference title 'Qwen2. 5-vl technical report' with a lowercase letter l (verified against digit-1 glyphs on the same page); OCR misread it as 'v1'. The source's own spacing 'Qwen2. 5' is preserved unchanged.

unresolved.evidence: Scattered axis values, pipeline-stage labels and task names around Figures 1-18 interleave with body text in OCR order; they are transcriptions of content shown inside the embedded figures and were left unchanged.
